author: Zo
title: Hiring character artist for team (gifs/videos + high-volume art)
content:
I need one more artist to add to my team.

Real art not ai slop.

Last time I made everyone around me minimum 6 figs. 2024-2025

Good artists are hard to come by but I need some for my time zone.

I’ll go into details of what I’m looking for not all requirements are needed.

- an artist to make videos or gif videos of the character for the project we are using per project

- high quality character art capabilities and the ability to have 10-20 art pieces within 24 hours time done

- crypto/meme culture ( not a requirement ) helpful though

Some of these I am more lenient but am willing to give anyone hard working a shot if they have talent.

Contact: DM @tisgambino
